languageModelTools.name: vanthrex_runQuery
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs ONE read-only Db2 for i SQL statement (SELECT, WITH or VALUES) on the IBM i connected in Vanthrex and returns up to 200 rows as text. Statements that change data are refused. Use it to look at data, catalog views (QSYS2.SYSTABLES, QSYS2.SYSCOLUMNS) and IBM i services (QSYS2.ACTIVE_JOB_INFO, QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS, …). System naming LIB/FILE works. Privacy: sensitive columns (passwords, card numbers, e-mails, salaries…) come back as xxxx and secrets as placeholders like xxxx1; on protected (production) systems only catalog and service views (QSYS2, SYSIBM, SYSTOOLS) can be queried, not table data. Libraries the user did not share are refused.

languageModelTools.name: vanthrex_readSource
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the text of a source member given as LIBRARY/FILE(MEMBER), e.g. MYLIB/QRPGLESRC(ORDENTRY), or of an IFS stream file given as an absolute path, from the IBM i connected in Vanthrex. Use it to read copybooks, called programs or prototypes.

languageModelTools.name: vanthrex_describeObject
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Describes an IBM i object given as LIBRARY/NAME (optionally with a type such as *PGM, *SRVPGM, *FILE): type, attribute, text, owner, size, dates, source member; for files also the columns (name, type, length, text) and indexes; for programs the bound modules and their source.

languageModelTools.name: vanthrex_searchObjects
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Finds objects on the connected IBM i whose name or text description matches a pattern (* is a wildcard), in the user's library list or in one library. Returns library, name, type, attribute and text. Use it to find the real table or program names before writing SQL or code.

pattern.description: Name or text, e.g. CUST* or customer

library.description: One library (optional; default the library list)

languageModelTools.name: vanthrex_systemStatus
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the connected IBM i's CPU and system ASP use, job counts, jobs in MSGW (waiting for a reply) and the latest QSYSOPR messages. Use it to answer questions about system health or stuck jobs.

languageModelTools.name: vanthrex_messageHelp
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the IBM help text (message, cause, recovery) of an IBM i message ID such as CPF9801, MCH1211, RNF7030 or SQL0204, read from the IBM message files on the connected system. Use it to explain an error message precisely.

languageModelTools.name: vanthrex_listMembers
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists the members of an IBM i source physical file (LIBRARY/FILE, e.g. MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) with their source type, last change date, number of lines and text, optionally filtered by a name or text pattern (* wildcard). Use it to find the source to read with the source tool.

pattern.description: Optional name or text pattern, * as wildcard

languageModelTools.name: vanthrex_commandHelp
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the definition of an IBM i CL command as it exists on the connected system: its prompt text and every parameter (keyword, prompt, default, allowed values, required or not). Use it before writing CL so that only real commands and parameters are used.

command.description: Command name, e.g. SBMJOB or QSYS/CRTBNDRPG

languageModelTools.name: vanthrex_indexAdvice
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the number of rows and size of a Db2 for i table (LIBRARY/TABLE), its indexes and logical files with how often queries used them, and the index advice the query optimizer recorded for it. Use it to explain or improve SQL performance. Reads metadata only.
